notes: Muto Locus, a room-shifting game started as a Ludum Dare 37 (One Room) entry and continued afterward (jam tag exists; this snapshot is default-branch master). Complete Unity 2019.1.0f2 project with playable MainMenu, Game, Level, Editor, and TheRoom scenes, plus 203 gameplay scripts. Code MIT (Copyright 2017 Mads Grau Kristensen). Art assets CC-BY-4.0 (same author, credited in upstream README). Bundled third-party: YamlDotNet Unity port (MIT, Antoine Aubry; license at src/Assets/YamlDotNet/YamlDotNet.license.txt); Space Mono font (SIL OFL, Google Fonts, credited in README); Font Awesome icon PNGs (Dave Gandy / fontawesome.io, credited in README). No DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no LFS, no DLL/EXE. ~41M src snapshot.
